notes.title: The Final update & the future
notes.notes:
Hello Landlords,

So today after a year of working night and day on forming this lump of clay into a game we have the final version of Landlord simulator. To start off we have addressed and added the following:

 The fps issue outside is now 100% solved and correct
 The fps in steppe is 100% solved and corrected
 A new mini game for fixing had been implemented and tested 
 The AI has been reworked and tested 
 A new pause addition has been added
 The tutorials have changed into an easier to read format 
 The tutorials will now act individually (so no more popping up if you have already closed it)
 The apartments have been Added and Tested 
 The stat screen has been changed 
 You will have to restart Sorry 

So going forward we are not going to be adding any more playable features to the game if anything is added if will be purely cosmetic. We have worked very hard to ensure we found and fixed any bugs and glitches that were there. But we will still remain vigilant if any more might arise. We will check the discussion here once a week  or so but the best way to let us know of any other problems is through our website. 

We want to thank everyone who has helped us get to this point and give us suggestion to what would be nice addition to the game. We implemented those that would not changed it into a different game than what we had imaged all the way in the beginning. We can’t be more thankful to everyone.

As we slowly transition to full release and into the start of a new game we will post any details here just in case you might want to follow it.

notes.title: Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Hello Landlords,

We wanted to let everyone know what is going on with the next update. So we have been working hard to ensure that all the bugs reported and found have been fixed and we have also been changing things within the game visually and adding a few new mechanics as well.
   If all continues on this path the next update will be out either tomorrow or Monday so keep a watchful eye out for that.

So As an edit to this above, completely overlooked the fact that Christmas is just a few days away. So with that we are going to try to have it out by the 27th or 28th but just before the end of December.  

Thank you
MasterCalamity Games

notes.title: v3.5.2 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello Landlords,

We were playing the new build and saw a lot of stuff that was left behind in the wake of these many updates. so this is a quick fix to bring up everything up to par, below is an overview of what has been fixed.

 Fixed abandoning home function
 Minigame maps updated
 Fixtures on businesses will not fall anymore
 Props in the market are now where they're supposed to be
 The stats in the left corner will not reset upon replaying a mini game
 Abandoned homes will no longer get issues
 Added random loading screen pictures


So of course as always enjoy the current build, if you notice anything out of the ordinary let us know in the links below or on our discussions here  and of course have fun.

notes.title: Great Update News
notes.notes:
Hello Landlords,

So Today we are so glad to say that the update is completely finished and in the testing phase now and so far everything works.  As of now we are just making some last minute changes to some wording or the way something looks, but unlike last time it’s actually working. So we won't go into any details right now this was more of a “hey it's testing and everything is looking good.” So in other news we are going to be releasing the update between the 28th and the 30th. This is to give the next update a more fresh time frame seeing how it is the last one. So keep an eye out on the 28th more than anything and continue to have fun until then.

MasterCalamity Games

notes.title: Update pushed back
notes.notes:
Hello Landlords,

I know that we have stayed on a pretty tight update schedule up to this point so I wanted to let everyone know that the new update is going to take a little more time up to this point so it will be out by the end of the first week of september.  We have a lot of things being done in this update such as the businesses  being added and more mini games along with fixing a few bugs that were found while testing last update round. So just keep and eye out for that and enjoy the current version until then. 

MasterCalamity Games

notes.title: Update on its way
notes.notes:
Hello Landlords,

Today we are working on finishing up the next update which is going to add more mini games into the fray. This will help with the amount of downtime between months especially if you have it on x3. Now why are we telling you this before the update we we want to ensure that if you have already purchased the game to turn tutorials on after the update to ensure you know about everything. We are adding a few more things so the tutorials will be very helpful especially in the park area.

That’s all for now.

MasterCalamity Games

notes.title: v2.6.3 bug fix

Thank you
